name: row-navigation
title: Row Navigation
description: One tab stop over a collection's rows on UI SDK roving focus: arrows and j/k move, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown jump, Enter opens, Space and x toggle. Adds no role.
docs: `useRowNavigation({ ids, onOpen, onToggle, reveal })` makes the instance; wrap the rows in `RowNavigationProvider handle` and each row (a `tr`, or a row's link or button) in `NavigableRow id render`. `ids` lists every row in order, rendered or not, so Home, End and PageDown reach rows a virtualized collection hasn't rendered: `reveal(id)` scrolls one into view and focus follows when it renders. Enter calls `onOpen` only for rows that aren't links or buttons, which open themselves. Keys typed in a control inside a row stay with that control. Agents don't see it: the rows' parts and the collection's own actions already cover them.
